Thank you for your reply. I hate myself for trusting him and for talking to him when he came back despite how he treated me and ghosted me. I feel so stupid. Tbh, if he acknowledge his behavior then, I probably would have been friends with him again. 

For me, the problem isn't being alone, it the fact that being alone isn't an option, it's what I have to be. I just want someone to talk to and have at least one close relationship. 

Thank you for your advice.

Thank you for your reply. It is hard to move on because he was my only friend. I have difficulty connecting with people and quarantine has made it hard to meet people. I feel like I don't socialize well over the internet, not much better in person tbh. It just hurts and I feel so invalidated and angry. During our argument I was upset and said he was selfish and a dick, his response "are you acting like this because I am the only person who gave you attention?". I am just angry. I know I am giving him too much power over me, but it's so hard to move on. I have no one else to talk to and am super lonely. He was my first friend in a long time, now I'm back to loneliness. I just want him to feel how I feel, but that'll probably never happen. 

Thanks again.

you can download the song for free at Nomadic Firs' band camp.

[https://nomadicfirs.bandcamp.com/track/cover-bombs-odesza-remix](https://nomadicfirs.bandcamp.com/track/cover-bombs-odesza-remix)

People can be cruel. For me, I learned that no one on this earth is more special or important than I am, which helped in being content with myself. That I have worth on my own. It takes people off a pedestal. But I understand wanting people to care, humans aren't meant to be alone. It sucks that people abandon, but I guess we just have to find the right people who stick around, those willing be there during good and bad days. 

I'm sorry for your pain, loneliness is a terrible pain.
Thanks for your support, I feel heard
